structured_output.title: ACME package patch may affect cert-manager ACME support
structured_output.content: The environment uses cert-manager v1.17.0 with ACME certificate resources (certificates.cert-manager.io/v1 CRD installed). The v1.18.0 change patches the internal ACME package to support ACME profiles extension. Although the environment summary does not explicitly show ACME profile configuration, this internal patch could affect ACME functionality. Inspect your cert-manager values and Certificate resources to confirm whether ACME profiles are used or relied upon; if they are, verify the patch does not alter behavior in v1.18.0.
